xBRIEFInfo.description: Scope xBRIEF for #2837 — accept documented xbrief:preflight -- <path> form

plan.title: bug(cli): documented xbrief:preflight separator form fails on v0.84.0

narratives.Description: The documented deft xbrief:preflight -- <path> form fails with unrecognized argument: -- while --vbrief-path works. Align the parser with verify:session-ritual (#2681) and fix --help so it does not evaluate a null path.
narratives.Overview: Consumer AGENTS.md and commands.md prescribe task-style separator-plus-positional syntax for the #810 implementation-intent gate. On v0.84.0 the CLI rejects the lone -- before lifecycle validation, blocking agents that follow generated instructions.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: 1) In packages/cli/src/vbrief-preflight.ts parseArgs, accept a lone -- separator (same as verify-session-ritual). 2) Make --help print usage and exit without calling evaluate. 3) Add regression tests for separator+path, --vbrief-path parity, help, and fail-closed unknowns.
narratives.UserStory: As an agent following AGENTS.md, I want deft xbrief:preflight -- <active-path> to work like --vbrief-path, so that the Implementation Intent Gate does not block on a parser mismatch.

items.title: Given an active running xBRIEF, when preflight uses -- <path>, then it matches --vbrief-path success.

narrative.Acceptance: Given an active running xBRIEF path, when deft xbrief:preflight -- <path> runs, then exit code and readiness match the same --vbrief-path invocation.

items.title: Given missing or non-running paths, when either form is used, then lifecycle failures match.

narrative.Acceptance: Given missing, non-active, or non-running xBRIEFs, when either documented form is used, then both produce equivalent non-zero lifecycle failures.

items.title: Given --help, when xbrief:preflight is invoked, then usage prints without null path evaluation.

narrative.Acceptance: Given deft xbrief:preflight --help, when the command runs, then it prints valid usage and exits successfully with no null path errors.

items.title: Given unknown args or missing path, when parse runs, then it fails closed without null placeholders.

narrative.Acceptance: Given unknown arguments or a missing path, when parse/run executes, then it fails closed with actionable messages and never emits a null path in the error text.

items.title: Given managed docs, when syntax is checked, then AGENTS/commands/help agree on supported forms.

narrative.Acceptance: Given managed AGENTS.md, agents-entry, commands.md, and CLI help, when syntax is reviewed, then they agree on the supported separator and flag forms.

references.title: Issue #2837: bug(cli): documented xbrief:preflight separator form fails on v0.84.0
